given: a SKU's stock record at a location carries a combined tracking code
when: a warehouse operator opens the detail view for that SKU
then: the combined tracking code is shown for that SKU's stock at that location
architectural_notes: E2E: the SPA detail view (client/) surfaces the combined tracking code carried on each stock_records row, delivered through the JSON boundary (app/routes/) -> stock-service (app/services/) -> stock-repository (app/repositories/) read against the paired branch DB. The tracking code is a persisted column on the record (not a computed cross-cutting concern); the service maps it into the per-location payload and the boundary returns it as JSON (R5). Independent of AC1's location/quantity rows: the code can be blank/missing while rows still render. Read-only, no write or validation concern owned here. Covered by the R4 branch integration test on the boundary plus a SPA component test asserting the code renders.

independence.rationale: AC1 covers the per-location rows (location + quantity); AC2 adds the tracking-code display, which can be broken (code missing or blank) while the location rows still render correctly, and vice versa
